Sunset together, on a boat that is only yours.

We leave Funchal marina at 18:30 and follow the coast west as the light goes gold. Drinks and food on deck, just your group on board, the drone at Cabo Girão when the wind allows.

The Sunset Trip: 2h to Cabo Girão, or 2h30 to Ribeira Brava and back into a lit up Funchal.

items.title: Sunset together

items.caption:
The view from our bow, with the Madeira coast ahead.
Terraced green hills, white houses and mountains behind, under a clear blue sky.
The water is a little choppy and deep blue, and we are in no hurry.
Madeira vista do mar é outra coisa.
Book direct on chifbay.com

Glasses up under the cliffs, a small table of snacks, and a group that is clearly in no hurry.
The rock face behind them runs red, brown and grey down to the dark blue water.
This is our boat, just your own people on board.
Saúde a todos.
Book direct on chifbay.com

Big smiles, pink drinks and a wooden table of crisps, parked below a wall of red and grey rock.
The sea is dark blue and a bit lively, and nobody minds.
That is the good kind of afternoon.
Que dia bom.
Book direct on chifbay.com

A huge cliff face rising straight from the sea, streaked with rust, ochre and grey.
At its foot there is a small pebble beach and a low pink wall, and deep blue water in front.
From the boat you see how big this coast really is.
A costa é mesmo outra escala.
